job.job_title: Infosys Evolve | GenAI Engineer | Women Returnship Program
job.job_description:
Upskill with purpose. Build expertise. Evolve with confidence.




Infosys EVOLVE is a structured career acceleration program designed for women professionals looking to build future-ready skills and stay ahead in the evolving technology landscape. As part of our Restart with Infosys initiative, we welcome women professionals returning to the workforce after a career break of 6 months or more, with a minimum of 2 years of IT experience.




What You Gain

Training in high-demand technologies
Curated learning paths aligned to your experience and career aspirations
Hands-on learning through projects, assessments, and expert mentoring
Enhanced readiness for future career opportunities



Role & responsibilities



Develop and support AI-powered applications using Python and Generative AI technologies.
Build solutions leveraging LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and RAG frameworks.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, and business workflows.
Participate in model testing, deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Collaborate with teams to understand business requirements and deliver AI-based solutions.
Follow Responsible AI, security, and governance guidelines.
Troubleshoot issues and support enhancements for deployed AI applications.
Contribute to reusable code libraries, automation assets, and knowledge repositories.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
